changes: Shortened 32 blog metadata titles while preserving article headings and URLs.
Changed the blog listing to hourly revalidation instead of rendering on every request.

Ranked related articles by topic overlap before broad category and recency.
Used real article update dates for structured data and sitemap; removed synthetic current timestamps from static sitemap entries.
Removed signup from the sitemap and set noindex for signup and query variants.
Corrected the missing Organization logo URL and Starter plan name in SoftwareApplication schema.
Made homepage reveal content visible before hydration and preserved off-screen animation as an enhancement.
Added a direct comparison-article link from the comparison hub for the comparison queries appearing in Search Console.
Refreshed the HoneyBook vs Dubsado vs Bonsai article using dated official sources and an explicit publisher-interest disclosure.
Removed five nonexistent cover references and generated 1200x630 PNG social previews for articles.
Rendered frontmatter FAQs visibly in articles to match FAQ structured data.
